reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but the new range handler independently implements the daily exclusion policy added to getNextDate.

duplication.why: Daily exclusion decisions are repeated between getNextDate and getDatesInRange, and the weekend-or-holiday predicate appears in three places.

placement.why: Holiday matching and movement belong in shared schedules, but the range handler also owns scheduling policy that should live in that shared layer.

scope.why: All edits address the requested scheduling rules, range handler, configuration plumbing, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several occurrence-processing paths because daily exclusion is separate from the adjustment helper used by existing consumers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange independently decides daily exclusions instead of sharing getNextDate's policy; getUpcomingDates and both budget/schedule-template.ts adjustment sites bypass that policy.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily exclusion decision is reshaped into an iterator-search branch in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate and a map-to-null branch in server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter, getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch, and getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates, and two budget adjustment sites operate outside that shared daily policy.
